meta.title: Optimize dataset query loops
meta.body_summary: Implement predicate pushdown in dataset query loops by detecting variables referenced in WHERE filters and pushing filters down to reduce intermediate data; add cross join filter pushdown test.

perf_labels.notes: Codex implemented a VM-level predicate pushdown optimization; author self-merged within 22 minutes with no review and only narrative/test evidence.

core_change_summary.description: In runtime/vm/queryutil.go (new file), implements detection of variables referenced in query predicates and pushes down WHERE filters into dataset query loops to avoid processing unnecessary rows. Modifies runtime/vm/vm.go to integrate the optimization. Adds test case cross_join_filter.mochi and expected outputs.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Test files added to validate the new predicate pushdown feature.
